elements.justification: 'vehicles' is admitted as DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle ('every device in, upon or by which any person or property is or may be transported or drawn upon a highway', with the definition's exclusions recorded by the run's reading of the aggregate), for the subject and for the other. 'proceeding in opposite directions': rel.oncoming, 'headings opposed and closing', with its tolerance; its exclusion concerns 'the direction a road user approaches from' an intersection, which these words do not name: they name two vehicles meeting on a way. 'proceeding': the subject is not at rest (negation of drv.motion.complete_halt, 'complete cessation from movement'). 'Drivers' is read through the vehicles' controlled motion.

'pass each other': the two are alongside, rel.longitudinal_overlap, 'the length the two footprints' projections on that axis share'. 'keeping to the right': each keeps the other on its left, rel.bearing, 'direction of b from a in a's frame (for "on the right of" …)', its lateral component on the subject's left. Both occupy the same highway (rel.occupies, 'a road user's footprint overlaps a lane / region'; st.highway, 'the entire public way between its boundary lines'), so a vehicle on another way is not met.

applicability: The subject is a vehicle (ru.aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle) that is not at rest (not drv.motion.complete_halt with p.halt_speed_tolerance).
obligation: For every road user c that is a vehicle, occupies a highway region the subject occupies (rel.occupies, st.highway), is oncoming to the subject (rel.oncoming with p.oncoming_heading_cos) and is alongside it (rel.longitudinal_overlap: the projections share length): c lies on the subject's left (the lateral component of rel.bearing(subject, c) is to the left). Violated where such a c lies on the subject's right.

narrowings.why: 'Drivers' is read through the vehicles' controlled motion, whoever or whatever controls them.
Passing each other is read as the two vehicles being alongside on the same highway; vehicles on different ways are not read as passing each other.

scenarios.name: forbid
scenarios.narrative: On a two-way road, an oncoming car passes the moving subject car on the subject's right side.

scenarios.name: permit
scenarios.narrative: On a two-way road, an oncoming car passes the moving subject car on the subject's left side.

scenarios.name: idle
scenarios.narrative: The subject car is at rest at the curb while an oncoming car passes.

scenarios.name: blind
scenarios.narrative: An oncoming car passes the moving subject car on the subject's right side; the source declares rel.occupies and rel.bearing absent, so whether the two occupy the same highway is not observed (and the measured bearing is not supplied), and the duty is unknown.

scenarios.name: branch_1
scenarios.narrative: The subject car drives alone on the road: no vehicle meets it.

param_proposals.name: p.oncoming_heading_cos
param_proposals.convention: cosine of the largest angle off exactly opposed headings (about 25 degrees) at which two vehicles count as proceeding in opposite directions
param_proposals.source: heading tolerance of road-geometry alignment; lane-change heading angles

param_proposals.name: p.halt_speed_tolerance
param_proposals.convention: the speed at or below which a sampled speed counts as no movement: the source's speed resolution
param_proposals.source: speed resolution of the acquisition source
